name: CEZ, a. s.
summary: CEZ, a. s. engages in the generation, distribution, trade, and sale of electricity, heat, thermal energy and other commodities in Central Europe. It operates through four segments: Generation, Distribution, Sales, and Mining. The company operates hydroelectric, wind, solar, nuclear, coal, photovoltaic, and biomass power plants, and combined cycle gas turbine power plant and combined heat and power units. It is also involved in the trade and sale of natural gas; mining of coal; quarrying and processing of construction aggregates and limestones; commodity trading business; and provision of energy services, as well as consulting services.
